tests: R14: narrativeClaim records a quoted span of an interview answer, or her own words; claimFindStep makes the find step on the claim's question or in the project (the assistant only proposes it)
R15: a claim reads as_recalled until a member ties a record to its find step and marks it found, then found, naming the record; its look is stated; never shown as what the body said
R16: a member who was present records her firsthand account through provenance's testify (its R28): testimony graded and labelled as hers; nothing here grades it or keeps it
R22: an interview answer or claim naming a person in no public role carries inquiry R59's warning at the act, never a refusal

R24: an owner closes a project that is not quiet with each of the three reasons; the project's document then records closed with the reason, which is all `project-stage` R2 reads (the owner's recorded act), the gaps read at the act kept beside it
R24: a member who is not an owner is refused, whichever of the three reasons, and nothing is written (control: the owner's close, and the quiet path still refuses a project that is not quiet)
R24: another word is CLOSE_BAD_REASON; a machine, a non-participant and a bad note are refused as R18's are; nothing is written
R25: the ops map serves projectclose and answers it as projectClose does
R25: investigation declares projectclose: its requires alone raise no refusal naming a field, each missing one is refused naming it, and a field outside accepts is dropped or refused
R25: the declaration states what the screen sends and what the arm reads: project, reason and an optional note, the reason a refusal when missing
R10: milestones, reports, the interview, claims and proposals are working material: never exported to the public, keyed by project and purged with it; no place named
R11: INTAKE_QUESTIONS is skills' one frozen list of six, read from there and never re-listed; the by-hand page asks exactly these

R12: interviewKeep, by a joined participant: each answer kept in her words as narrative, with whether it began as the assistant's draft and was kept unchanged or edited; a project-placed step of the project
R12: an interview is never evidence or a leg target: the check registered with promotion refuses it, INTERVIEW_NOT_A_LEG (C-146.26), never hypotheses' NARRATIVE_NOT_A_LEG
R13: interviewOf answers the project's participants the kept interviews, each labelled as the member's own account
R1: milestoneSet, by a joined participant, waits on the project's questions and its steps; each refusal writes nothing

R1: a project not at FULL is answered as membership R44 says: at EXISTENCE an act or read naming the project is refused PROJECT_SEEN_NOT_A_PARTICIPANT carrying only its id and name (a hidden one's owners to an administrator), at NONE it is absent, and nothing inside it is widened
R1: milestoneRevise, milestoneRemove and milestoneItemRemove, each with history and a reason where one is owed
R2: met only when each item is done (this project's conclusion; a step ended); deferred, dismissed or set aside reads stuck, naming it; nearing and overdue only display
R3: milestonesOverdue answers each overdue milestone once to each joined participant, keyed per milestone and date; a reminder she asked for, to her alone on that day; nothing else
R4: milestones are never shared: another project drawing on the same question sets its own; no answer about one reaches outside its project
R5: a milestone is the group's own date: never a duty, standard, clock or finding; nothing registers it as one
R20: planPropose stores a proposed question or step drawn from a member's words, labelled the system's; never a question or step until accepted
R20: planAccept is the member's one accepting act (record-grammar R52): a step by steps in her name, a question by her own promotion; own_instead sets it aside for her words
R21: every act here has a path by hand that needs no AI; the assistant only proposes
R23: planAccept refuses a planning proposal absent or unseen with NO_SUCH_PLANNING_PROPOSAL (C-146.21, its translation kept), never intent's NO_SUCH_PROPOSAL
R17: quietState is quiet when every step of the project and its questions is ended or set aside and nothing is awaited; a display, never a stage
R18: quietPrompts answers once per quiet spell to the joined participants: the objective, its condition, progress and gaps, and the doors; nothing more is asked in that spell
R18: projectCloseWithGaps closes the project with its closed_reason (intent R29), the gaps read at the act kept beside it

R19: projectStanding answers the objective and condition, progress (or that it cannot be computed), each question's legs grouped for and against with this project's conclusion beside the bar, and the gaps; no score, no member's share

R18: watchArrival (K2524), for monitoring: something new from a watched project's source reopens its work, so a later quiet spell prompts again; answered with the project's reads; a project not watched is refused, writing nothing
R18 (T42, N846): watchArrival never throws once the arrival is written: each read is taken after the write and one that fails answers {unread}; a refusal or a failure before the write records nothing

R18 (T42, N846): watchedProjects carries every source intent R7 names for a watched project, following its cursor to the end; a project whose sources cannot be read whole answers watch: null with watch_unread, never a partial set
R6: reportDraft composes by code, with no AI, the steps taken and ended (outcomes, learned lines), what was found and what is waiting, each line citing its source; it writes nothing
R6: since the last report kept for the project (or that question in it); only what the viewer may see enters
R7: reportKeep, by a joined participant, kept as she keeps it, dated, with its author, never edited after; reportsOf answers the participants
R8: no draft or report states a figure about an individual member: handles appear only as attribution, never counted, ranked or compared
R9: no report is required or scheduled; nothing reminds anyone to write one

R23: planAccept refuses a planning proposal absent or unseen with NO_SUCH_PLANNING_PROPOSAL (C-146.21, its translation kept), never intent's NO_SUCH_PROPOSAL
